description: Histogram by CBT Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All Features Included Histogram by CBT renders the distribution of a single continuous numeric measure as an interactive bar chart, binning values automatically or by a fixed count, width, quantile, or custom edges you type in yourself. This helps business audiences see how a measure such as spend, salary, or wait time is actually spread across its full range, surfacing skew, outliers, and patterns a single average hides. Key Capabilities Flexible Binning: Automatic, fixed count, fixed width, quantile, or fully custom bin edges. Weighted Bin Height: Count, sum, average, minimum, or maximum of any bound field. Statistical Overlays: Mean, median, mode, percentile, and custom reference lines, a standard deviation band, and a normal curve fit. Multi-Series and Small Multiples: Stacked or overlaid bars, a frequency polygon, or small multiple panels with independent axes and normalization. Outlier Bin and Log Scale: Collapse extreme values into their own bin, or switch to a logarithmic axis. Configurable Axis Formatting: Independent display units and decimal precision on both the bin axis and the value axis. Full Cross-Filtering Support: Native selection, right-click context menus, tooltips, and keyboard navigation.
